name: TextPressure-TS-TW
title: Text Pressure
description: One large word spans the stage and each letter's weight, width and slant follow the pointer: characters close to the cursor fatten and widen while distant ones stay thin.
use: A single big word should react to the pointer through typographic weight rather than motion.
avoid: Small type or paragraph copy: the effect only reads at display size.
a11y: Letters are real text, but the pointer-follow loop always runs and ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: The word "PRESSURE" runs in large uppercase white letters across a black stage, stretched edge to edge. Letters vary in thickness and width along the line, some hairline thin and others heavy and broad.
behaves: Whichever letters are nearest the pointer swell into a bold, wide style while the far letters thin out, easing toward the new shape each frame. Sliding across the word carries the heavy zone with the cursor.
customise: The word, font family and URL, width/weight/italic toggles, colour, stroke, scale and minimum size are props. The pointer maths runs in a fixed loop.
weight: moderate: A requestAnimationFrame loop measures and restyles every letter each frame.
polishWhy: Strong variable-weight typography; one plain word keeps the demo narrow.
